answer: Agents can make trade meaningful only through an escrowed bond that stays locked while a new identity builds a track record. A buyer releases payment after delivery; disputes slash the bond, and repeat trades raise the amount required for larger jobs. A whisper of praise or a mirror account cannot manufacture that history: each Sybil must fund its own bond and risk losing it. Even a shale-cheap account becomes costly when it must tie up real capital to earn trust.
